title: ProtocolSchemaRoot
description: Root schema bundle exported for JSON Schema -> TypeScript generation.

AccountEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authenticated account session epoch.

AccountScope.description: Redacted local scope identifier isolating accounts in cache/state.

oneOf.description: Read activity with a caller-chosen bounded preference window (1..=500).
The user removes a recorded DJ preference from the desktop.
The owner clears a temporary listening intent from the desktop.

intentId.description: The intent as shown; one that replaced it since then is kept.

oneOf.description: The owner clears all temporary listening intents for the current account.

listeningIntents.description: Active temporary listening intents for the current account.

preferencesTotal.description: All preferences of the account; more than `preferences` when only the newest are shown.

AgentListeningIntentSummary.description: A temporary listening intent as the desktop activity view displays it.

value.description:
The setting (`preferInstrumental`, `steady`, `gaming`, ...), the brief as written, or the
dismissed occasion's id.

action.description:
What the operation did, as a stable key (`play`, `enqueue`, `rememberTaste`, ...) that the
interface words in its own language.

AgentPreferenceSummary.description: A recorded DJ preference as the desktop shows it.

playbackIndexes.description:
Aligned 1:1 with `tracks`: the provider's 0-based watch index of each track in
`audio_playlist_id`. Non-empty only when `audio_playlist_id` is present.

uiLanguage.description: Settings saved before the UI language existed load as English.

AppSettingsPatch.description: Partial settings update sent by the UI so concurrent edits to other fields are preserved.

AssetId.description: Content-addressed local cover asset identifier generated by Rust storage.

AudioQualityLevel.description: The official page's own quality label of an audio stream (its LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH).

BridgeEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one authorized page bridge handshake.

audioBitrateKbps.description: The playing audio stream's average bit rate in kbit/s, from the same source.

audioItag.description:
The stream number (itag) of the audio stream now playing, as the official player's own
statistics name it. It identifies the audio format; `quality_label` is a video label.

audioQuality.description:
How the official page itself labels the playing audio stream, read from its player
response for that stream number. Absent when the page does not say.

bufferedMs.description: How far the current track has loaded, from its start, in whole seconds (as ms).

BrowseId.description: Opaque YouTube Music browse endpoint identifier.

queueClear.description: The page would clear the upcoming entries now (finite queue without a continuation).

queueFilter.description:
The page offers Up Next filters that can be selected now. Selecting one replaces only
YouTube Music's own suggestions; the current track and the explicit list are kept.

CoreEpoch.description: Unique identifier for one Rust core process instance.

CredentialRevision.description: Monotonic/opaque revision for credential material rotation.

EnvironmentConfigPayload.description:
Core -> Host: holiday region config sent whenever owner config changes or on host hello.
Never carries `scene_city` or registered principals.

HostEnvironmentSnapshotPayload.description: Host -> Core: local clock & offline holiday snapshot computed in Electron main.

MomentDesktopSnapshot.description: Core -> Main UI: desktop Moment DJ settings + registered principals + live principal preview.

OfficialUpcoming.description:
YouTube Music's own continuation after the explicit list (its autoplay suggestions). These
are read-only facts: they are not queue occurrences and cannot be selected, moved or removed
through queue edits.

tracks.description: Loaded suggestions in play order, at most [`MAX_OFFICIAL_UPCOMING`]; only for `observed`.

oneOf.description: Autoplay is on and suggestions are loaded: `tracks` play after the explicit list.
Autoplay is on, nothing is loaded yet and the page is fetching suggestions.
Autoplay is off: suggestions the page still holds will not play, so none are listed.
The queue is a radio that refills itself; its own entries are what plays next.
Autoplay is on but no suggestions are loaded or being fetched.

OwnerMomentConfig.description: Owner-managed Moment DJ privacy and local context configuration stored strictly on desktop.

sharedPrincipalsByAccount.description: Per-account allowlist of registered MCP principal names granted Moment access.

sceneCity.description: User-entered city mood context (max 80 chars), or `""` to clear.

PlaybackContext.description: Playlist identity and index read from the official page's selected native queue item.

queueFilterId.description: An Up Next filter id read from the current queue snapshot.

audioBitrateKbps.description: The playing audio stream's average bit rate in kbit/s, from the same source.

audioItag.description:
The stream number (itag) of the audio stream now playing, as the official player's own
statistics name it. It identifies the audio format; `quality_label` is a video label.

audioQuality.description:
How the official page itself labels the playing audio stream, read from its player
response for that stream number. Absent when the page does not say.

bufferedMs.description: How far the current track has loaded, as last reported by the page.

oneOf.description:
Selects an Up Next filter (`queueFilterId`): replaces only YouTube Music's own
suggestions, without interrupting the current track. Observed once the snapshot shows
that filter selected.

QueueEntryId.description: Occurrence-scoped queue entry identifier within a bridge epoch.

QueueFilter.description:
One Up Next filter as the page shows it. `filter_id` is opaque: it names this chip for the
suggestions it steers (their seed), so an id read while other suggestions were offered, for
example before the listener changed songs, matches nothing and is refused.

explicitComplete.description:
The explicit, non-radio list is loaded from its first to its last entry. An autoplay
tail after it can still make `completeness` partial; the explicit end stays provable.

filters.description:
The Up Next filters (steering chips) the page offers now, in its order. Absent when none
are offered or they could not be read.

mayLoadMore.description:
The page keeps a continuation for the explicit list, so more entries may load after the
last loaded one even when the loaded list looks complete. Official album queues keep one
after every entry has loaded, so it does not by itself mean that anything follows.

officialUpcoming.description:
What the page plays after the explicit list on its own. Absent when the page state was
not readable; never mixed into `entries`.

filters.description: The Up Next filters the page offers now.

loadedStart.description: Absolute queue position of the first loaded entry, when the page reports it.

officialUpcoming.description:
The page's own continuation after the explicit list, at most
[`MAX_PREVIEW_OFFICIAL_UPCOMING`] tracks.

previewEntries.description:
A slice of the loaded window anchored on the current occurrence: a few played entries
before it, then what follows. Without a current occurrence it is the window's start.

previewStart.description: Index of the first preview entry within the loaded window.

SessionMaterialPayload.description: Host -> Core secret session material. NEVER logged, serialized to disk, or forwarded to UI.

TrackInstanceId.description: Unique playback instance identifier (distinguishes repeated plays).

UiLanguage.description: The language the UI is shown in. Values are the UI's BCP 47 locale tags.
